detail.longDescription: GHManage 0.9.4 is out, for Windows and the Mac. - Command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P): type part of a command's name to hear how many match and what Enter will run. - Help, Keyboard Shortcuts (Ctrl+F1): every key in one list you can filter. - Delete takes any repository out of your list; File, Hidden Repositories brings it back. - A quieter Search GitHub dialog. Installed copies update themselves. Notes and downloads: https:// github.com/TheIdeaPlace/GHMana ge/releases/tag/v0.9.4 # GitHub # ScreenReader # Accessibility
